title: The craft's forge is two stage values kept in step by hand: CraftStage::Forging (UI) and CraftRun::Crafting (session)
trigger: craft_now starts the forge on the UI side when the driver accepts craftGift; craft_frame_upkeep ends it only when both the 3 s timer and craft.crafting() allow, and after_craft_pop reads both to decide whether the craft may go
effect: No bug traced; each side must be cleared with the other (a lost answer would leave Forging with crafting() true and the ring spinning)
fix: one stage value: Forging { since, request } whose answer ends it, with the session holding only the result

title: FileAskOutcome::Sent is an 'asked once' flag: the download's answer is never matched
trigger: gift_market_frame_upkeep calls download_file for each sticker file shown by the open box and records Sent; a download that later fails leaves Sent in requested_files, so nothing asks again while the boxes stay open
effect: A sticker of the gift market that failed to download shows its placeholder until every market box is closed (drop_orphans clears requested_files)
fix: FileAsk::Sent { request: RequestId } cleared by the file's answer, or ask through the session's own file state

title: A refused volume send leaves the slider on the dragged value
trigger: Release the stage volume slider while set_group_call_participant_volume returns None (send refused)
effect: stage is set to Made(made), which equals the server level, so serves() keeps the dragged slider and it shows a volume the server never got (the Sent stage snaps back, this path does not)
fix: on a refused send leave the stage so the slider is made again from the server level

title: GroupCallScreen::window_closed_by_user is an Option<call id> dismissal flag cleared by hand from many sites
trigger: Set in close_group_call_window, on_window_should_close, the stream-ended sync and a failed window open; cleared in show_group_call_window and note_stream_join_intent; sync_group_call_window reads it to decide whether the call window exists
effect: No bug traced (call ids do not repeat in a client and the screen owns the value), but the 'window wanted' decision is spread over a CallWindow stage, this Option and StreamWatch
fix: a CallWindow::Dismissed { call } variant set and cleared only by CallWindow transitions

title: baseline: StreamFacts::transport_failed
trigger: StreamFacts is rebuilt every draw from call.transport.error().is_some(); settle_stream_join reads it to end a join that failed without a join error
effect: No bug; the real stage is the call's transport value, this bool is a per-draw snapshot of it
fix: carry the transport stage (or Option<&str> error) in StreamFacts instead of a bool

title: sticker-pack busy is matched by purpose+chat, not the RequestId of the change
trigger: Pick a pack in two windows of the same chat, or an older request for the chat is in flight
effect: Buttons disabled by another request's presence; the click handler itself never checks busy so a fast double click sends twice
fix: Keep the sent RequestId in the pack-choice stage and compare it

title: Edit box stage is reset by hand at three call sites instead of its own close path
trigger: Save with nothing changed, Save in demo mode, or Save whose send list is empty: the box is dropped with admin.group_edit_box = None
effect: close_group_edit_box also clears the emoji panel and earn.ask_boost; these three exits skip the second (and rely on the first being called at the top of save)
fix: Route every exit through close_group_edit_box (or make the box own its sub-state so replacing it whole is enough)

title: global probe cache keeps a bare Probing stage with a detached notify task; no owner and no way out if the probe job hangs
trigger: Open a chat with an HDR picture on a stalled network drive; the probe job never returns
effect: The file's HDR badge/viewer stays off for the rest of the process (Probing is never retried)
fix: Entry::Probing { job: Task<Option<bool>> } held per window slot, or Fetch<bool> keyed by path

title: InlineBotNotice {Unconfirmed, Confirmed} is a bool kept as a two-variant enum
trigger: User confirms the inline-bot notice in a session
effect: Not persisted beyond the account's OnScreen; shape is just confirmed: bool
fix: A persisted setting (settings store) or drop the notice state if the confirmation is a per-session fact

title: MembersStage::Loading carries a RequestId that nothing reads (dead_code expected)
trigger: Open a group info panel while its member list loads
effect: Stage names a request but the answer is matched by (chat, filter) in the session, not by this id
fix: Drop the unused request field or settle the list by it (Fetch<T> keyed by RequestId)

title: A clip whose sync open fails is opened again on every render
trigger: A visible muted GIF/video tile whose VideoPlayer::open returns Err (file unreadable or unsupported)
effect: frame() runs open() each frame because the slot never exists; wasted decoder setup per render, still shows the still picture
fix: Insert a Stuck slot (Presence::Stuck) when open fails so the tile is retried only when its source changes

title: apply_custom_bindings returns silently when the keymap is borrowed, but the caller still records Keymap::Applied(account)
trigger: An account's keybindings are applied (notifications/mod.rs apply_pending_keybindings) while the GPUI keymap RefCell is borrowed; try_borrow fails and the function returns without installing anything
effect: Keymap says it carries the account's overrides, so apply_pending_keybindings never retries; the account's custom chords (or the previous account's chords remain) until the next rebind or account change
fix: apply_custom_bindings returns bool/Result; caller sets Keymap::Applied only on success

title: A recent language pack deleted then re-picked stays in LanguageBox::removed; a later Restore inserts a duplicate into recent
trigger: Settings > Language: delete recent pack X (removed=[X], dimmed row stays clickable), pick X (install_language -> with_recent puts X back in recent; removed still holds X), pick another pack Y so X is no longer checked, open X's menu: it offers Restore (removed.iter().any) and remove_recent_language(restore=true) inserts X again at recent[index] with no duplicate check
effect: Two rows for the same pack with the same element id, and a duplicate saved in language_recent.json
fix: install_language drops a re-picked pack from LanguageBox::removed (or remove/restore keyed as one list of RecentEntry{choice, Kept|Removed(index)})
